content.title: Prime Video’s ‘La Oficina’ Premieres: What To Know About ‘The Office’ Mexican Remake
content.text: Fernando Bonilla (center) stars as Jerónimo Ponce III and incompetent boss in the Mexican adaptation of "The Office."Amazon MGM StudiosRicky Gervais's The Office is making a comeback in Spanish, with a Mexican twist. Prime Video is reviving the franchise in a new setting: a soap factory in the heart of Mexico. The new take, La Oficina, premieres March 13. It has been over two decades since Gervais first introduced the world to his groundbreaking workplace comedy in the original UK version (2001–2003), and more than a decade since the U.S. adaptation on NBC concluded its hit nine-season run in 2013. Both series were set in the mundane world of fictional paper companies. Their success inspired more than a dozen international adaptations, including a short-lived one-season version in Chile called La Ofis. Now, the franchise kicks off a new run via streaming, bringing the format to Spanish-language audiences worldwide with a locally authentic spin.Meet the staff of "La Oficina".Amazon MGM StudiosWho's Who in La OficinaThe mockumentary follows the daily headaches of a workforce forced to navigate the whims of a boss who is fundamentally unqualified for the job. Fernando Bonilla (The Dead Girls, Technoboys) stars as Jerónimo Ponce III, the heir and regional manager of the Jabones Olimpo soap empire. Jerónimo's authority stems entirely from family lineage, adding a layer of nepotism meets incompetence to the workplace dynamic.MORE FOR YOUThe staff of Jabones Olimpo features a diverse ensemble of comedy veterans and rising stars: Abi Delgado (Alejandra Ley): a sales rep who runs a side-hustle "tiendita" (little shop) out of her deskMine Romero (Alexa Zuart): a marketing specialist tasked with maintaining the upscale image of the company's Aguascalientes branchAniv Rubio (Edgar Villa "Villita")Memo Guerrero (Fabrizio Santini)Sofi Campos (Elena del Río)Qwerty (Armando Espitia) - Systems: if the system crashed, he probably disconnected itÁngeles Leyva (Areli González) - Quality ControlLucio Galván (Juan Carlos Medellín) - Legal: his specialty is not winning cases, it's avoiding themBetty Benitez (Paola Flores) - Secretary: the one who truly runs the place and keeps the company's secretsDon Abel (Guillermo Quintanilla) - Accounting: so old school he prints his emailsGiancarlo (Rodrigo Suárez) - Head of Brand Ambassadors: the first line of contact with clientsMondra (Quetzalli Cortés) - Human Resources: doesn't bite, she just comes from Mexico CityCañedo (Arturo Vinales) - ???: The less you know about Cañedo, the betterAuthenticity in AdaptationBy moving the setting to Aguascalientes and centering the story on a family-run manufacturing business, La Oficina aims to capture the office worker culture of Mexico while staying true to the irreverent, fly-on-the-wall spirit of the original BBC creation.The production brings together a powerhouse creative team to ensure the humor translates authentically to a Mexican context. Gaz Alazraki, the director behind the record-breaking Nosotros los Nobles and the hit series Club de Cuervos, serves as director and executive producer. He is joined by showrunner Marcos Bucay (Guadalupe Reyes, Cómo Sobrevivir Soltero), as part of a global deal between Amazon MGM Studios and Máquina Vega.The series is part of Prime Video's ambitious 2026 Latin American slate, which also includes La Casa de los Espíritus (The House of the Spirits) and El Juicio (The Trial), as Amazon Studios doubles down on hyper-local stories with global appeal. Email Address La Oficina premieres exclusively on Prime Video on March 13, with all eight episodes available the same day.
